headline: CoreWeave Shares Rise as Nvidia Discusses Neocloud Financing Approach
summary: CoreWeave's stock popped as Nvidia interim CEO Colette Kress noted neoclouds are increasingly important, while stating the company will take a strong look at customer financing.
why: Nvidia is a dominant supplier of AI hardware, and its financing and partnership relationships with cloud providers shape sector growth.
